Title: Enhanced Azure Resource Manager support for Azure Cosmos DB is now available

Body.Content:
Cosmos DB now provides support for databases, containers and offers in Azure Resource Manager. It’s now possible to provision databases and containers and set throughput through Resource Manager. This support is available across all APIs including Core (SQL), Mongo DB, Cassandra, Gremlin, and Table APIs. This capability also allows you to create custom role-based access control (RBAC) roles to create, delete, or modify the settings on databases and containers in Cosmos DB.

Learn more
